你是外贸合规审核员。下面给你一段待发布的文本，以及一组规则（每条有编号、规则原文摘录和要判断的问题）。

只根据给出的规则判断。另外会给你工厂与产品资料，用来核对待审文本里的价格、条款、材料、认证等事实；资料本身不是待审对象。
如果待审文本与资料一致、也符合规则，就不要报。对每一个问题：
- 必须写 `rule_id`：只能是下面列出的规则编号之一。
- 必须写 `quote`：从待审文本里逐字复制出有问题的那一小段（不超过 20 个词）。
- 写不出规则编号或原文片段的问题，不要输出。宁可漏报，不要编造。
- severity：red = 明确违反规则；amber = 有风险、需要人确认。
- problem_zh / suggestion_zh 用简体中文，suggestion 给出具体改法。

只输出 JSON：
{"findings": [{"rule_id": "...", "quote": "...", "severity": "red|amber", "problem_zh": "...", "suggestion_zh": "..."}]}
如果没有问题：{"findings": []}

content: {"findings": [{"rule_id": "ALI-03", "quote": "Our portable blender [model no.] is FCC certified (Part 15B). We can send you the test report for review.", "severity": "red", "problem_zh": "工厂没有 FCC SDoC 测试报告（资料中列为未持有），声称已获 FCC 认证并可提供报告属虚假信息。", "suggestion_zh": "删除 FCC 认证说法，改为：\"We currently hold CE (EMC) and UN38.3 reports. FCC testing can be arranged at buyer's cost if required; please advise.\""}, {"rule_id": "ALI-03", "quote": "BPA free, with an [FDA / LFGB] food-contact test report available.", "severity": "red", "problem_zh": "只有材料供应商的 BPA-free 声明，没有成品第三方报告，也没有 FDA/LFGB 食品接触报告。", "suggestion_zh": "改为：\"The cup body is made of Tritan; we can provide the material supplier's BPA-free declaration (no finished-product third-party report at present).\""}, {"rule_id": "ALI-01", "quote": "The cup body is made of [Tritan / food-grade PP]", "severity": "amber", "problem_zh": "资料显示杯体为 Tritan，备选项 PP 与实物不符。", "suggestion_zh": "删除占位选项，直接写 \"made of Tritan\"。"}, {"rule_id": "ALI-01", "quote": "we have [350ml / 380ml / 500ml] in [colors]", "severity": "red", "problem_zh": "BL-35P 只有 350ml 一种容量，380ml/500ml 无资料支撑。", "suggestion_zh": "改为 \"Capacity: 350ml\"，颜色按工厂实际可选色填写。"}, {"rule_id": "ALI-02", "quote": "Shipment within 25 days is [achievable", "severity": "red", "problem_zh": "工厂标准交期为 35 天，承诺 25 天出货没有依据。", "suggestion_zh": "改为：\"Standard lead time is about 35 days after artwork approval and deposit.\" 如需加急，须先向工厂确认后再答复。"}, {"rule_id": "ALI-02", "quote": "USD [X.XX]/unit FOB [Shenzhen / Ningbo]", "severity": "red", "problem_zh": "工厂只走宁波-舟山港，不能报 FOB 深圳。价格也未填写；按资料，1000-4999 件为 USD 6.20。", "suggestion_zh": "改为 \"USD 6.20/unit FOB Ningbo\"（2,000 件）。说明买家目标价 5.20 低于 5000 件以上的价格 5.70，不要暗示能做到。"}, {"rule_id": "ALI-02", "quote": "Your preferred FOB port", "severity": "amber", "problem_zh": "工厂只能从宁波-舟山出货，让买家选 FOB 港口会误导。", "suggestion_zh": "删除此问，注明 FOB 港口为 Ningbo。"}, {"rule_id": "ALI-02", "quote": "We can do this for free.", "severity": "amber", "problem_zh": "资料中没有免费 FBA 贴标服务。", "suggestion_zh": "删除\"免费\"承诺，改为 \"Please let us know; we will confirm feasibility and cost.\""}, {"rule_id": "ALI-03", "quote": "we can also provide the UN38.3 report and MSDS for the lithium battery", "severity": "amber", "problem_zh": "资料只有 UN38.3 报告，未列出 MSDS。", "suggestion_zh": "先与工厂确认是否有 MSDS；若没有，只写 UN38.3 report。"}, {"rule_id": "ALI-03", "quote": "We offer [silk-screen printing / laser engraving] on the cup body or base.", "severity": "amber", "problem_zh": "资料只写明彩盒可印 logo（1000 个以上免费），杯身丝印/镭雕能力无依据。", "suggestion_zh": "改为：\"We can print your logo on the color box (free for 1,000+ units; vector file required).\" 杯身印刷须先向工厂确认。"}, {"rule_id": "ALI-03", "quote": "we'll send you a digital mockup within 24 hours", "severity": "amber", "problem_zh": "24 小时出效果图的承诺没有资料支撑；资料要求买家提供矢量稿。", "suggestion_zh": "改为 \"Please send a vector file (AI/PDF); we'll send a mockup for approval shortly.\"，或先确认实际时效。"}, {"rule_id": "ALI-03", "quote": "Portable blender cups are one of our best-selling items for Amazon sellers", "severity": "amber", "problem_zh": "\"亚马逊卖家热销款\"的说法没有资料证实，可能误导。", "suggestion_zh": "删除，或改为客观描述产品卖点（USB-C 充电、杯体分离自动断电等）。"}, {"rule_id": "INC-02", "quote": "FOB [Shenzhen / Ningbo]", "severity": "amber", "problem_zh": "2,000 件约 50 箱，通常走拼柜集装箱，FCA 可能更合适，但回复未提示。", "suggestion_zh": "保留 FOB Ningbo，同时补充：\"FCA Ningbo is also available if you prefer, which suits containerized/LCL shipments.\""}]}
